body:
## What's Changed
* docs: document human-task output metadata and refresh validation rule counts by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/59
* fix(ci): grant id-token to reusable npm-publish job by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/60
* chore(deps): update dependency @xyflow/react to v12.11.6 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/61
* fix(deps): update junit-jupiter to 6.1.3 by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/67
* ci(deps): update GitHub Actions and CI node version (major) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/68
* fix(deps): update vite to 8.2.2 and vitest to 4.1.11 by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/65
* fix(deps): update typescript to 6.0.3 by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/64
* fix(deps): update @dagrejs/dagre to ^3.1.1 by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/62
* feat(editor): make the properties panel resizable by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/69
* feat(editor): allow Delete key to remove selection by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/70
* Select among multiple node visits in WorkflowViewer (#52) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/72
* Use array of {key, value} pairs for map-based inputs in PropertiesPanel (#54) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/71
* Fix non-string input values mangled through String.valueOf by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/76
* Fix: preserve error context when edge condition evaluation fails by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/77
* chore(deps): update dependency org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-compiler-plugin to v3.16.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/78
* chore(deps): update dependency @types/react-dom to v19.2.7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/79
* Avoid extra render per keystroke in MapInputsEditor by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/81
* Standardize array access on bracket notation in condition expressions by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/75
* chore(deps): update dependency @types/react-dom to v19.2.7 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/80
* Fix MapInputsEditor focus/IME misdirection on row removal (#73) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/83
* Detect and report all independent automated cycles by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/pull/82


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-flow/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4
